stubs.name: serve
stubs.doc: Server_serve runs one connection: it makes a Client for sock, buffers incoming data into lines (CRLF, or a bare LF), parses each into a Message, dispatches it through handlers by its upper-cased command, and calls Server_disconnect when the socket ends or errors. Never throw out of a socket event handler.

stubs.name: send
stubs.doc: Client_send writes one protocol line to c's socket. line carries no trailing CRLF and is already complete, including any leading ':'; Client_send only appends CRLF, and does nothing once the socket is closed.

stubs.name: reply
stubs.doc: Server_reply sends c a line from the server itself, built in full: ":" + serverName + " " + code + " " + target + " :" + text, where target is c.nick, or "*" before c has a nick.

stubs.name: prefix
stubs.doc: Client_prefix returns c's prefix, nick!user@freeq-lite, WITHOUT the leading ':'. Every sender of a prefixed line adds the ':' itself (":" + Client_prefix(c) + " JOIN ..."), including QUIT.

stubs.name: disconnect
stubs.doc: Server_disconnect removes c from the server and from every channel, tells the channel peers ":" + Client_prefix(c) + " QUIT :" + reason (once each), then closes c's socket.
